subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: Should the remaining fix define a shared Gateway partial-reload/readiness contract across `sessions.resolve` and Control UI, or should it stay scoped to the WebChat notice/restart-recovery subset already covered by the linked PR?
rationale: Current source shows several partial mechanisms, but choosing the durable user-visible contract spans Gateway readiness, session RPC semantics, Control UI UX, and macOS launchd recovery behavior.

options.title: Define Shared Degraded State
options.body: Make Gateway expose a single reload/readiness state and have session RPCs plus Control UI render a temporary degraded/retry state instead of misleading session-missing errors.

options.title: Land The WebChat Notice Subset
options.body: Accept the linked PR as a narrow improvement for blank WebChat recovery while leaving broader partial-reload readiness behavior for a separate follow-up.

options.title: Require Live macOS Repro First
options.body: Pause design work until maintainers or reporters reproduce the launchd/plugin-maintenance incident on current main with `/readyz`, WebSocket, and Control UI evidence.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Degraded State
recommendation.body: Make Gateway expose a single reload/readiness state and have session RPCs plus Control UI render a temporary degraded/retry state instead of misleading session-missing errors.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties steipete to Gateway startup sidecars, hot reload isolation, and method metadata; the remaining decision is broad Gateway product behavior rather than a single narrow code defect.
